title: crypto2dev TLS: TLS 1.3 integration test
description: Write an integration test that performs a complete TLS 1.3 handshake and data exchange with crypto2dev active on both client and server. Use wolfSSL's example client/server infrastructure. The test should: (1) configure both sides with wc_crypto2dev_assign_devid(), (2) complete a TLS 1.3 handshake (ECDHE-AES256-GCM-SHA384 or similar), (3) exchange application data, (4) verify the session completes without error, (5) log which operations were served by hardware (via a test-mode counter in the shim) vs. software fallback. Run using the crypto2dev simulator so no kernel module is needed.
notes: Use wolfSSL's existing tests/unit.test infrastructure or examples/server.c + examples/client.c. The test should work with the simulator (no /dev/crypto2dev needed). Expected hardware ops: AES-GCM record encryption, HMAC-SHA384 Finished message. Expected software fallback: ECDHE shared secret (raw Z needed), transcript hash (Copy required).
